text: At this time the model does not identify any specific changes that are guaranteed to flip the decision for your profile. In other words, there isn’t a single, verified step—such as adjusting a particular debt‑to‑income ratio or adding a new type of account—that the system knows will move you from “low risk” to an approved status. While you can still work on general credit‑building habits (paying existing balances down, keeping credit‑card utilization low, avoiding new hard inquiries, and maintaining steady income), none of these actions are confirmed by the model to change the outcome on their own. Continuing to strengthen your overall financial picture is the best approach.
